name_input: M/S I.B.M INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; M/S IBM INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; IBM INDIA PVT.LTD; IBM INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; IBM INDIA PVT LTD
note: Registry verification could not be completed in this session: DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection refused, Google returned HTTP 429, Bing returned only generic IBM corporate pages, and the registry aggregators (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, instafinancials.com, quickcompany.in, indiafilings.com) returned HTTP 403/404. MCA master-data portal returned HTTP 403. Therefore CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state and MCA status are all reported as null rather than guessed — no value here is invented. What is publicly known and uncontested: IBM India Private Limited is the Indian subsidiary of International Business Machines Corporation and is an active operating entity (not struck off/liquidated/bankrupt), so it is NOT rejected. Role assessed as service_provider (IT services, software and hardware sales/support), not a manufacturer; the declared HS 847170 (storage units) is a product code for goods it resells/imports rather than evidence of own manufacturing — per project rule this is not a rejection ground. Revenue FY25/FY26 in INR crore: null — IBM India files audited accounts with MCA/Registrar of Companies but the figures were not retrievable from an official filing in this session, and no number is estimated. Recommended follow-up: pull the MCA master data by CIN and the GSTIN from the GST portal / a public GST profile before any commercial decision.
